title: Peri-Peri Paneer Tikka 🔥🧀 smoky & spicy from scratch #shorts

segments.moment_description: Coating the paneer cubes in peri-peri marinade
Threading the paneer and veggies onto skewers
Grilling the paneer tikka over fire
Eating the smoky peri-peri paneer tikka

description:
Peri-Peri Paneer Tikka 🔥🧀 — soft paneer cubes coated in fiery peri-peri masala, skewered with peppers and onion, and grilled till smoky and charred. Restaurant-style, made at home.

Peri-peri or classic tandoori paneer tikka — which one wins? 👇 Comment!

🌿 Marinated in peri-peri seasoning, yogurt, garlic and lemon, then char-grilled with bell peppers and onion — spicy, smoky and vegetarian.

Did you know? 'Peri-peri' comes from the African bird's-eye chilli — pairing that heat with soft Indian paneer is the fusion that makes this tikka addictive.
